body:
Clearer ownership of explanations, removing duplications:

- **`interfaces.md`** keeps the script-vs-YAML comparison with a merged
  mapping table. Its two code walkthroughs, duplicated on
  `first_simulation.md` and `scripting_simulations.md`, become links to those
  pages.
- **`parameters.md`** merges into `configuration.md` as "Overriding parameters"
  (TOML format, the `toml:` key, ClimaParams links). Both inbound references
  retargeted.
- **`longruns.md`** is deleted; it opened by declaring the Buildkite pipeline
  the authoritative list. `global_simulations.md` now points at
  `.buildkite/longruns_gpu/pipeline.yml` and `config/longrun_configs/`.
- Various renames to be consistent with dev-guides policies
title: Restructures docs interfaces
